parameters.content:
## Price Ingestion Agent
Receipt half of price ingestion (the Price Refresh Agent covers the other half: scheduled live web-scrape refreshes for items not recently repurchased). Reuses the same dedicated household Telegram bot as Check-In/Budget Alert — send it a photo of a receipt, it extracts every line item via vision LLM and writes them straight into Catalog + PriceLog with confidence: receipt, no 24-48h staging hold, since a receipt is a real observed purchase (ground truth), not an estimate.

Same structured-JSON-only extraction discipline as the Price Refresh Agent (CLAUDE.md §5, 'never free text'). New items (never before in Catalog) are created via appendOrUpdate rather than the Price Refresh Agent's plain update, since a receipt can introduce a first-time item.

STATUS: built 2026-08-09, not yet wired with real credentials or live-tested — needs the same live-application pass as every other agent in this project (Telegram bot credential, Google Sheets credential, Anthropic credential, real spreadsheet ID).

nodes.name: Listen for Receipt Photo
nodes.notes: Fires on every message to the bot, from anyone (same shape as the Check-In Reply Listener) — the next node filters to the household chat, the one after that filters to photo messages only, so this bot can keep handling check-in text replies and receipt photos on the same trigger.

parameters.text: Send a photo of your receipt and I'll log the prices — the whole receipt in one shot is fine, no need to crop per item.

nodes.name: Download Receipt Photo
nodes.notes: Downloads the actual image bytes as binary (n8n's Telegram node resolves file_id → file_path → download internally, so the bot token never needs to be handled directly in this workflow). Binary lands on the default 'data' property — verify this live; if n8n uses a different default binary property name for this node/version, update the base64 reference in 'Extract Receipt via LLM' accordingly.

nodes.name: Extract Receipt via LLM
nodes.notes: Structured-JSON-only extraction, same discipline as the Price Refresh Agent's 'Extract Price via LLM' (CLAUDE.md §5). Vision content block references the downloaded photo's base64 binary directly — same anthropic-version header requirement already confirmed live 2026-07-31 on the Price Refresh Agent.

parameters.text: Couldn't read that receipt clearly — could you try again with a flatter, better-lit photo? Cropping out anything but the item lines and totals can help too.

nodes.name: Split Items
nodes.notes: One output item per receipt line, so each can be upserted into Catalog and appended to PriceLog independently below.

nodes.name: Upsert Item into Catalog
nodes.notes: appendOrUpdate (not the Price Refresh Agent's plain update) since a receipt can introduce a first-time item never before in Catalog — matched on item+store, same compound key the Price Refresh Agent uses. unit_price is deliberately left blank here rather than computed, since a receipt-printed size alone isn't enough to safely derive it without risking the exact kind of unverified cross-store comparison CLAUDE.md's caution-icon convention exists to prevent — leave that to manual entry or a future pass.

nodes.name: Append to PriceLog
nodes.notes: Always a plain append — PriceLog is append-only history (schema doc), never matched/overwritten. status: receipt distinguishes these ground-truth rows from the Price Refresh Agent's pending/promoted scrape rows at a glance.

nodes.name: Format Confirmation Message
nodes.notes: alwaysOutputData not needed here since Validate Extraction already guaranteed items.length > 0 before this branch was ever reached.

nodes.name: Send Confirmation
nodes.notes: Set On Error to Continue once wired live, same safety pattern used on every other Telegram send in this project (Send Finalize Summary etc.) so a Telegram hiccup can never take down the ingestion itself — the sheet writes above have already succeeded by this point regardless.
